name: application-response-summary-bar
title: Response Summary Bar
description: Per-option horizontal result bars with percentage and raw response count, both computed from real counts and the total across all options.
useWhen: Displaying closed-ended survey or form question results as a read-only summary, after responses have been collected.
Each option benefits from both a percentage and its underlying raw count shown together.
You want a compact list of thin progress bars rather than a card styled to invite an active vote.
avoidWhen: You're presenting an interactive poll a user can still vote on — use `poll-vote-card` for that vote-first card treatment instead.
There's no meaningful total to compute percentages against — show raw counts alone instead of a bar.
You have many (10+) options — this compact list becomes a bar or column chart instead.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width card (max-w-md) with bars spanning the full row width; label and percent/count text wrap rather than overflowing at narrow widths.
accessibility: Percentage and raw count are both derived from the same options[].count values and the same computed total, so they can never disagree.
Every bar's fill percentage is shown alongside its numeric percentage as real text, not conveyed by bar length alone.
The response total footer sums the same option counts driving the bars above it, so it always agrees with the visible breakdown.

variants.title: Response Summary Bar
variants.description: Satisfaction survey results across 4 options (Very satisfied 45%, Satisfied 30%, Neutral 15%, Dissatisfied 10%) totaling 240 responses.
accessibility: Bar width, percentage text, and count text are all computed from the same option.count and total values.

variants.title: Response Summary Bar (Dark)
variants.description: Response summary bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Bar and text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
